payload.title: Automatic release pipeline + first 0.1.1 cut (npm/Swift/Android)
payload.description: release-autotag.yml auto-fires on a chore(release): commit to main (gated on head commit msg; also workflow_dispatch), creates+pushes framework-v/swift-v/android-v tags via RELEASE_TAG_TOKEN, which trigger publish-npm (trusted publishing/OIDC, --provenance), publish-swift (FrickSwift mirror), publish-android (GitHub Packages). Cut 0.1.1: all 9 @fricken/* packages live on npm, FrickSwift tagged 0.1.1, Android SDK published. Fixed 4 latent publish bugs surfaced on first run (npm heredoc, Android pnpm version conflict, Swift checkout token clobber, Android demo :app gate). Secrets RELEASE_TAG_TOKEN + SWIFT_MIRROR_TOKEN scoped as fine-grained PATs.
